name: meetingrecorder
description: Find and read your MeetingRecorder meetings: list, search, transcripts and summaries.
long_description:
Lets Claude work with the meetings you record with MeetingRecorder. Claude can list your meetings by date, search them by topic, person or project, and read full transcripts and summaries.

Everything is read from the recordings folder on this Mac. The extension is read-only and makes no network requests: your meetings go only to your own Claude conversation.

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: List recorded meetings by date: title, date, duration and a one-line gist.

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Find meetings by words in the title, summary or transcript, with snippets.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Full transcript of a meeting, in parts for long ones.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Short gist and full summary of a meeting.
